# Siemens Contrast Tool

**Author:** Skylord<br/>
**Platforms:** x35/x45/x55 (EGOLD)

<div className="screenshot">

![Siemens Contrast Tool: screenshot 1](./siemens-contrast-tool/img/siemens-contrast-tool.png)

</div>

This program is intended for adjusting the contrast on Siemens phones. This may
be necessary, for example, after upgrading an S/ME45 to an S45i, when the phone
works but nothing is visible on the screen.

After connecting the cable and switching to Service Mode, the contrast from 0 to 63 can
be changed with the slider or entered as a number, and the result is immediately visible on the display. The button
`Read contrast` reads the current value, and `Write contrast` saves the selected
value to the phone.
